controls.requirement: Owner separately authorizes a disposable no-provider test scope; no implicit live dispatch
Observer and executor run under externally established distinct principals
Observer and executor use independently controlled host trust boundaries
Agent source mounted technically read only, with independent pre/post capture
No provider keys or connected-app credentials exposed to executor
No network egress from disposable executor and no writable privileged sockets
Reduced Linux capabilities, no-new-privileges, read-only root filesystem, bounded resources
Exact source commit and content digest independently verified; immutable image digest pinned
Observer key independently provisioned; verifier registry and revocation governance
Replay and idempotency journal atomic and durable; clock provenance independently checked
Capture artifacts hashed outside executor with signed provenance and evidence custody
No canonical release approval from host report alone; inherited Omega 09M gates retained

negative_probes.purpose: Executor reads a synthetic credential canary outside allowed mounts
Executor escapes source root through symlink or parent traversal
Executor attempts privilege escalation or privileged socket access
Observer rejects replay nonce or duplicated attestation
Verifier rejects mismatched immutable source commit
Lost or ambiguous task response cannot trigger automatic retry
Independent before/after source snapshot digests remain unchanged
